Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
eval_framework/
│
├── core/
│   ├── models.py               ← Evaluation data models
│   ├── llm_judge.py            ← LLM-as-Judge scorer
│   └── metrics_base.py         ← Base metric classes
│
├── evaluators/
│   ├── rag_evaluator.py        ← Full RAG pipeline metrics
│   ├── retriever_evaluator.py  ← Retriever-specific metrics
│   ├── agent_evaluator.py      ← Agent behavior metrics
│   ├── tool_evaluator.py       ← Tool usage metrics
│   └── e2e_evaluator.py        ← End-to-end system metrics
│
├── scenarios/
│   ├── 01_rag_scenarios.py     ← All RAG eval scenarios
│   ├── 02_agent_scenarios.py   ← Agent eval scenarios
│   ├── 03_tool_scenarios.py    ← Tool eval scenarios
│   └── 04_e2e_scenarios.py     ← Full system scenarios
│
├── datasets/
│   ├── rag_testset.py          ← RAG test dataset
│   ├── agent_testset.py        ← Agent test dataset
│   └── tool_testset.py         ← Tool test dataset
│
├── reporters/
│   ├── console_reporter.py     ← Terminal output
│   └── json_reporter.py        ← JSON/CSV export
│
└── main.py                     ← Run all evaluations
```
